title: Fix To Do field formatting in task card state badges
description: The state badge on task cards in the TecFactory task board displays the raw value 'todo' instead of the human-readable label 'To Do'. Similarly, 'in-progress' should display as 'In Progress'. The renderTasks() function in app.js directly outputs task.state without mapping it to a display label. Add a state label map (similar to originLabels) so badges show formatted text: todo → To Do, in-progress → In Progress, developed → Developed, done → Done.
